definitions.explanation: A hostile person or group that one is fighting against.

examples.japanese: {敵|てき}が{近|ちか}づいてきた。
{敵|てき}を{倒|たお}して{勝|か}った。
examples.english: We defeated the enemy and won.

examples.japanese: {油断|ゆだん}は{大敵|たいてき}だ。
examples.notes: Proverb: {油断|ゆだん}{大敵|たいてき}

examples.japanese: あの{国|くに}は{長|なが}い{間|あいだ}{敵|てき}だったが、{今|いま}は{友好|ゆうこう}{関係|かんけい}にある。
examples.english: That country was an enemy for a long time, but now they have a friendly relationship.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{手強|てごわ}い{敵|てき}だ。
{敵|てき}に{勝|か}つには{練習|れんしゅう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need practice to beat the opponent.

examples.japanese: {強敵|きょうてき}に{出会|であ}った。
{敵|てき}を{知|し}り{己|おのれ}を{知|し}れば、{百戦|ひゃくせん}{危|あや}うからず。
examples.english: Know your enemy and know yourself, and you need not fear a hundred battles.

examples.japanese: {今度|こんど}の{試合|しあい}の{相手|あいて}は{強|つよ}い{敵|てき}だが、チーム{一丸|いちがん}となって{戦|たたか}おう。
examples.english: Our opponent in the next match is strong, but let's fight together as a team.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{敵|てき}に{回|まわ}す (to make an enemy of)
・{敵|てき}を{作|つく}る (to make enemies)
・{敵|てき}を{倒|たお}す (to defeat the enemy)
・{敵|てき}に{勝|か}つ (to win against the enemy)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{大敵|たいてき} (great enemy, nemesis)
・{強敵|きょうてき} (powerful enemy)
・{天敵|てんてき} (natural enemy, predator)
・{無敵|むてき} (invincible, unbeatable)

PROVERB:
・{油断|ゆだん}{大敵|たいてき} (Carelessness is one's worst enemy)
